The crew reached the end of the round.
The ship ran out of hull.

A crew member left the round.
Maneuver needs engine output and a ready cooldown. Ask Engineer for power.
Requested output: %1$d · waiting for server confirmation
Not enough power. Coordinate with Engineer and Shields.
That action is active or cooling down.
That station belongs to another player.
The action is out of date. Use the current controls.
No confirmation arrived. The action may have happened; checking current state.
The action was not sent. Wait for the connection to recover.
The action cannot be applied in the current state.
Everyone has one job. Everything goes wrong at the same time.
Create a room or join your friends, read your station briefings and coordinate the ship together.
Waiting for your private station briefing from the server.
These instructions are for your stations. Tell your crew what they need to know.
You operate Engineer and Shields. Read both stations before acknowledging.
Read every owned station and acknowledge within one minute. The server controls the deadline.
Briefings complete. Gameplay is not available in this build.
Briefing paused while a crew member reconnects. The deadline is paused too.
Briefing timed out before everyone acknowledged.
A player left. This briefing was aborted; leave to create a new room.
A player did not reconnect in time. This round was aborted.
This briefing was aborted. Leave the room to try again.
Choose your name. Join the same room code as your friends.
1–20 characters. Spaces at the ends are ignored.
Six letters or digits from the room code. Case does not matter.
Use a name without control characters.
Use six letters A–Z (except I and O) or digits 2–9.
Waiting for the server. Back cancels this attempt.
Could not send the request. Check your connection and try again.
Room not found. Check the code with your host.
This room already has three players.
The server is full. Try again later.
The server could not accept these inputs. Check your name and code.
The server could not accept that request. Refresh your connection and try again.
Your session ended. Create or join a room again.
You left on this phone. The server may keep your seat briefly while the connection closes.
Waiting for the current lobby from the server.
At least two players are needed.
Wait for every player to reconnect or leave.
The server is not ready to start.
This build supports lobbies. Starting a round is not available yet.
Your membership will end. Cancel to stay with your crew.
Configure a valid debug endpoint before connecting.
The reply did not arrive. The command may have happened; it will not be resent automatically.
The server message could not be understood. Current state must be refreshed.
The connection was interrupted. Retry or disconnect.
Automatic recovery has stopped. Disconnect or try again explicitly.
No room was joined before the admission deadline.
Uses the configured debug server. Test membership creates a temporary room for recovery checks, without opening a lobby screen. Unadmitted connections expire after ten seconds.
This preview contains no live room or game view.
A future lobby will show the server room code, players and readiness.
Your assigned stations and private instructions will come from the server.
Station controls and shared ship status will appear when gameplay is connected.
The server will supply the team outcome and round results.
Impact lane: %1$s · %2$.1f s. Ask Engineer for maneuver power or call Shields for cover.
Cool to %1$d or below and output %2$d or below · %3$.1f s. Coordinate power with the crew.
Hold output at %1$d or below while Shields stays off until the warning clears · %2$.1f s.
Cover %1$s with active shields and enough energy at impact · %2$.1f s. Ask Pilot which lane is threatened.
Deactivate shields and keep them off until the warning clears. Ask Engineer to reduce output · %1$.1f s.
The server starts the round. Controls unlock when gameplay begins.
Countdown paused while the crew reconnects.
Ready up for another round. The host can also return everyone to the lobby.
Another round needs 2–3 connected, ready players.
The host chooses another round or returns the crew to the lobby.
